engineProposal: PostgreSQL reference dialect; not user-confirmed production choice

tables.name: accounts
columnDefinitions: status text NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('active','deletion_pending','deactivated'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: auth_identities
columnDefinitions: account_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id)
provider text NOT NULL CHECK (provider IN ('google','apple'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: auth_sessions
columnDefinitions: account_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: stores
columnDefinitions: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('active','suspended','closed'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: memberships
columnDefinitions: store_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES stores(id)
account_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: protocol_profiles
columnDefinitions: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('draft','enabled','revoked'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: assets
columnDefinitions: kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('native','erc20'))
decimals smallint NOT NULL CHECK (decimals BETWEEN 0 AND 255)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)
CHECK ((kind = 'native' AND token_address IS NULL) OR (kind = 'erc20' AND token_address IS NOT NULL))
indexStatements: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assets_native_unique ON assets(chain_id) WHERE kind = 'native';
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX assets_token_unique ON assets(chain_id, token_address) WHERE kind = 'erc20';

tables.name: operations
columnDefinitions: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('queued','running','succeeded','failed','unknown','cancelled'))
updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: idempotency_records
columnDefinitions: created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: outbox
columnDefinitions: created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)
indexStatements: CREATE INDEX outbox_unpublished ON outbox(created_at,id) WHERE published_at IS NULL;

tables.name: inbox
columnDefinitions: processed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: audit_events
columnDefinitions: created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: wallets
columnDefinitions: kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('hardware_eoa','cloud_mpc_eoa','smart_account'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: wallet_bindings
columnDefinitions: wallet_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)
CHECK ((account_id IS NOT NULL)::int + (store_id IS NOT NULL)::int = 1)
indexStatements: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallet_account_active ON wallet_bindings(wallet_id,account_id) WHERE account_id IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL;
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX wallet_store_active ON wallet_bindings(wallet_id,store_id) WHERE store_id IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL;

tables.name: devices
columnDefinitions: state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('unprovisioned','assigned','active','return_pending','quarantined'))

revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: rentals
columnDefinitions: device_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES devices(id)
account_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id)
state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('assigned','active','return_requested','return_pending','returned'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)
indexStatements: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_rental ON rentals(device_id) WHERE state <> 'returned';

tables.name: device_bindings
columnDefinitions: device_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES devices(id)
account_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id)
wallet_origin text NOT NULL CHECK (wallet_origin IN ('new_travel','imported'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)
indexStatements: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX one_active_device_owner ON device_bindings(device_id) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL;

tables.name: enrollments

account_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES accounts(id)

revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

operation_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES operations(id)

state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','signing','completed','aborted','failed'))

revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: recipient_configurations
columnDefinitions: store_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES stores(id)
wallet_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES wallets(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)
indexStatements: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX current_store_recipient ON recipient_configurations(store_id) WHERE retired_at IS NULL;

tables.name: menu_items
columnDefinitions: store_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES stores(id)
fraction_digits smallint NOT NULL CHECK (fraction_digits BETWEEN 0 AND 18)
availability text NOT NULL CHECK (availability IN ('available','sold_out','hidden'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: orders
columnDefinitions: store_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES stores(id)
state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('awaiting_payment','paid','cancelled','expired','fulfilled'))
fraction_digits smallint NOT NULL CHECK (fraction_digits BETWEEN 0 AND 18)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: order_lines
columnDefinitions: order_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: payment_attempts

asset_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES assets(id)

revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: transaction_intents
columnDefinitions: profile_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES protocol_profiles(id)
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

tables.name: transaction_submissions
columnDefinitions: intent_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES transaction_intents(id)
state text NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('prepared','submitted','unknown','observed','failed'))
submission_kind text NOT NULL CHECK (submission_kind IN ('eoa','user_operation'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)
CHECK ((submission_kind = 'eoa' AND tx_hash IS NOT NULL AND userop_hash IS NULL) OR (submission_kind = 'user_operation' AND userop_hash IS NOT NULL))
indexStatements: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX submission_eoa_unique ON transaction_submissions(chain_id,tx_hash) WHERE submission_kind = 'eoa';
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX submission_userop_unique ON transaction_submissions(chain_id,userop_hash) WHERE submission_kind = 'user_operation';
CREATE INDEX submission_bundle_lookup ON transaction_submissions(chain_id,tx_hash) WHERE tx_hash IS NOT NULL;

tables.name: payment_evidence
columnDefinitions: kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('erc20_log','native_transaction'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)
CHECK ((kind = 'erc20_log' AND log_index IS NOT NULL AND log_index >= 0) OR (kind = 'native_transaction' AND log_index IS NULL))
indexStatements: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX evidence_log_unique ON payment_evidence(chain_id,tx_hash,log_index) WHERE kind = 'erc20_log';
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX evidence_native_unique ON payment_evidence(chain_id,tx_hash) WHERE kind = 'native_transaction';

tables.name: chain_observations
columnDefinitions: block_number numeric NOT NULL CHECK (block_number >= 0 AND block_number = trunc(block_number))
receipt_status text NOT NULL CHECK (receipt_status IN ('success','reverted'))
canonicality text NOT NULL CHECK (canonicality IN ('canonical','orphaned','unknown'))
created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)

order_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id)

observation_id app_id NOT NULL REFERENCES chain_observations(id)

revision bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (revision >= 0)
